findings.text: Finding: New users abandon onboarding at the CSV import step because the column-mapping screen is confusing; import is the main setup blocker.
Finding: New users cannot tell which plan includes CSV import; the pricing page is unclear about plan limits.
Finding: New users want overdue-invoice reminders sent by text message, not only by email.
Finding: New users can tell which plan includes CSV import; the pricing page is clear about plan limits.
Finding: New users do not find the duplicate-invoice action; they rebuild repeat invoices by hand.
Finding: New users complete the CSV import step without trouble; the column-mapping screen is clear and import is not a setup blocker. The main blocker is SSO configuration.
Finding: Admins need an exportable audit log of who changed invoice templates before they will roll out to all seats.

context.text: Signup mix, Q3 2026: 74 percent of new accounts are self-serve signups and 26 percent are enterprise trials.
Change log 2026-05-20: the pricing page was redesigned with a plan comparison table that lists CSV import limits per plan.
Change log: the CSV column-mapping screen has not changed since January 2026.
Q4 2026 roadmap question: should the team fund a redesign of the CSV column-mapping screen?
Research ops note: when two findings disagree, the team's habit is to keep the finding from the most recent study.
